bio: Sir Dannos seems the perfect knight – strong, dutiful, and kind. But he left his realm behind in search for the one he lost: Princess Irialla, his lifelong friend and confidant. Sir Dannos could not protect her from the Demons that stole her, but he will scour all of Amara to get her back.
